evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/k/a carries plugin name 'Loadouts', config group 'loadouts', description 'Set up and switch between loadouts', panel tag and enabled/hidden plugin metadata.
Startup constructs rs/gui/b/h, installs it as the loadout panel singleton, loads ldt_icon.png, creates a navigation button titled 'Loadouts' at priority 0 and registers it with ClientUI.
The wrapper owns only plugin/navigation lifecycle for the Loadouts panel; R386 does not infer a semantic identity for rs/gui/b/h beyond that ownership relation.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 SpawnPK plugin identity normalized to LoadoutsPlugin.
